messages.subject: Use unmarked to analyse group of species (Carnivore, Herbivore, and omnivore)?
parts:
Hi, I’m new with the package Unmarked and I'm not really used to all the universe of occupancy modeling.


I want to regroup species (herbivore, carnivore, and omnivore) with a set of data from camera trap survey. Can I regroup the presence\absence data from few species to a commune presence/absence sheet and analyzed it like if it’s only one?


After that, I want to compare the occupancy and abundance, if I can, of each group between three different zones (each zone have 25 cameras). I don’t have the same number of species for each group and my objective is not to know the species richness between my zones like what I understand from the model who uses the aspect community (Dorazio & Royle, 2005, Mackenzie et al., 2006 ).  


Someone did something like that before o know if I can do this with Unmarked?


Can I use the occuRN with a group of species like that?


Thanks you

Fred
